items.name: Reed Crown Circlet
items.lore: A circlet of woven reeds. The bogmen made it for a king.

items.name: Bog-King's Ring
items.lore: Bone and black amber. Too large for a man's hand; it fits anyway.

items.name: Lily-Pad Mantle
items.lore: Green and slick and strangely warm. The bogmen are better weavers than they look.

items.name: Marsh-Warden's Belt
items.lore: Brec's spare. It has a pocket for everything.

items.name: Signet of the Vigil
items.lore: The ring of a drowned order of knights. Their oath is engraved inside: 'Until relieved.'

items.name: Banner of the Vigil
items.lore: The order's banner, cut down to a cloak. It is still wet, months later.

items.name: Corentin's Sword-Belt
items.lore: A good knight's belt, worn smooth where the sword rode.

items.name: Relief-Bell Charm
items.lore: A tiny bronze bell, the kind that rang the changing of the watch.
